slots.hair: in a layered wolf cut, being tucked behind one ear
slots.outfit: an oversized white t-shirt slipped off one shoulder over shorts
slots.place: sitting on her bed late at night with takeaway boxes open around her, one warm bedside lamp on
slots.action: She is sitting cross-legged on the bed tucking her hair behind her ear with one hand and holding chopsticks in the other.
slots.face: Still chewing, her eyes laughing at the lens, a sentence cut off halfway.
slots.light: The bedside lamp is in front of her and low and the rest of the room is dark.

slots.hair: a layered wolf cut, pushed back
slots.outfit: a fitted orange fine-strap camisole and cotton shorts
slots.place: sitting on the floor of her room with her back against the bed, her phone screen lit
slots.action: She is scrolling a camera roll that is nothing but food with one hand and braced on the floor with the other.
slots.face: Her lip tint is eaten off and she has not replaced it; the corner of her mouth is very satisfied.
slots.light: The phone screen and the bedside lamp are both in front of her and low, and everything behind her is dark.

slots.hair: wet, being pushed behind her ear
slots.outfit: a steam-white towel wrapped round her, her shoulders still wet
slots.place: in her bathroom straight out of the shower, water on the mirror
slots.action: Her free hand is pushing the wet hair back behind her ear the way she always does.
slots.face: Not properly awake yet, but she laughs once at the lens.
slots.light: The light above the mirror is directly in front of her and the steam takes the depth of the room.

slots.hair: a layered wolf cut, tucked behind one ear
slots.outfit: a red fitted cropped knit with a wide neckline and high-waisted jeans
slots.place: at a stall with a single table beside the Busan market late at night, steam coming up off the pot
slots.action: She is tucking her hair behind her ear through the steam, about to start eating.
slots.face: Extremely expectant, eyes wide and her mouth already open.
slots.light: The warm bulb over the stall is in front of her, the steam is lit through, and the street outside the stall is black.

slots.outfit: an orange cropped top and wood-brown wide trousers with her waist bare
slots.place: on a small street of shops by the Busan seafront that are still open late, the signage warm
slots.action: She is walking between the shops with a bag of hot food in one hand and tucking her hair back with the other.
slots.face: Laughing out loud with her teeth showing, the whole face lit up.
slots.light: The warm shop signage is in front of her and the far end of the street goes dark.
